findings.issue: en does not match jp: まったくお手上げだ means 'I'm completely at a loss / I totally give up' (idiom お手上げ), not 'everything's a little crazy'. It contradicts pt ('Estou completamente sem saída') and both expl fields.
findings.current: Everything's a little crazy right now.

findings.issue: Token list starts with two stray duplicate tokens 話し and 方 (null glosses) BEFORE まるで, breaking sentence order; 話し方 is already correctly tokenized as one token later. Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1] so the list starts at まるで.
findings.current: tokens[0]=話し(はなし), tokens[1]=方(かた) precede まるで, out of order
findings.suggested: Remove tokens[0] and tokens[1]; token sequence should begin with まるで.

findings.issue: Note misclassifies し in 失礼しない as 連用形. The negative auxiliary ない attaches to the 未然形; しない uses the 未然形 し of する (the corpus itself uses 未然形 correctly in sent:tatoeba-195054). Fix both pt-BR and en versions of the note.
findings.current: raiz conectiva 連用形 し de する, antes do auxiliar de negação
findings.suggested: raiz 未然形 し de する, antes do auxiliar de negação (en: 未然形 stem し of する, before the negative auxiliary)

findings.issue: In 〜なくては the は is the binding particle, pronounced わ; the corpus phonetic convention converts it (cf. のは→のわ in sent:tatoeba-195378). Romaji 'shitsureishinakuteha' should likewise end 'nakutewa'.
findings.current: もうそろそろしつれいしなくては。
findings.suggested: もうそろそろしつれいしなくてわ。

findings.issue: The set farewell また明日 is read またあした; あす is a formal/literary register reading not used in this fixed phrase. Romaji 'mataasu' should likewise become 'mataashita'.
明日 in this casual farewell formula reads あした, not the formal/literary あす.
ほか (他/外) is a noun, and に is tokenized separately; the bare token is not an adverb — only the phrase ほかに functions adverbially. Role 'advérbio' teaches the wrong POS.
findings.suggested: substantivo (com に forma a locução adverbial 'além de')

findings.issue: 熱い means 'hot' (as the natural en and the token gloss 'hot (to the touch)' say); lit_en 'warm' understates it and is internally inconsistent.
その = 'that (near the listener)' per the token gloss/note, and lit_pt correctly uses 'esse'; lit_en renders it 'this'.
Stray 'de' before 'incrível': すごい数の客を mirrors as 'incrível número (の=de) público'; the leading 'de' corresponds to nothing in the Japanese and makes the mirror unparseable.
findings.current: Da Madonna o show, de incrível número de público juntou.
findings.suggested: Da Madonna o show, incrível número de público juntou.
